input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 imposes full-term sole-supplier exclusivity on us for hosted analytics, with no product-category narrowing, no 12-month limit and no performance-based exit — this is walk-away territory under the rule and fails the fallback. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity commitment. We propose making the appointment non-exclusive (preferred position) and preserving Section 12.3 unchanged.

ops.oldText: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: Vendor will be a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services to Customer, and Customer may procure equivalent services from any third party.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot commit to a sole-supplier arrangement, so we have made Vendor's appointment non-exclusive. This also removes the conflict with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that we have given no exclusivity commitment.
proposal.summary: Make Vendor a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services
